summary.description: Diuron is a white crystalline herbicide with no odour, used primarily on agricultural land. It breaks down quickly in hot water and light, but can persist in soil.
emission_sources: Use as a herbicide on agricultural land
environmental_impact: Toxic to fish and aquatic invertebrates, with potential long-term aquatic effects
Binds strongly to soil and may persist for months or years
May cause harm to blood and possibly cancer in humans if overexposed

top_sdg_impacts.SDG6_Clean_Water_and_Sanitation: Diuron is toxic to aquatic organisms and can persist in water and soil, threatening the quality of freshwater resources.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: Its agricultural use and long persistence in soil call for better management practices to reduce environmental contamination.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG14_Life_Below_Water: Diuron is highly toxic to fish and aquatic invertebrates and may cause long-term damage to aquatic ecosystems.
